newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish bank merger never before board - paper.
newsitem.headline: Swedish bank merger never before board - paper.

text.p: The rumoured possible merger between two of Sweden's big four banks, S-E-Banken and Handelsbanken had never come up at board level at S-E-Banken, a board member told a Swedish newspaper on Tuesday.

Rolf Blom, chairman at Finansforbundet and personal representative on S-E-Banken's board, told Finanstidningen that it would be sensational if not unbelieveable if the bank's leaders had dicussed a merger without informing their board.

Shares in S-E-Banken and Handelsbanken rose on Monday after a newspaper report at the weekend that the two banks were in talks about a possible merger. Neither of the banks would comment on the rumour.
